draw.about: TakeAimAsset geometry (game.swf, extraction-notes.json) in its own units; Brasa draws it at `scale` world px per unit around the shot origin. line: the original's dotted hand (dots from 15 to 58.95 units from the pivot) drawn as one solid, slightly transparent line (user request, 20/10/2026). arcCenter: centre of the arc's rim relative to the hand pivot, +x towards the back of the body, fitted on faixa-angular.png. Plate: the Brasa degree readout, not part of the original asset.

source: Original paintings made with Codex image generation from the TakeAimAsset study (output/player-hitbox-aim-reference), 19/10/2026; built by scripts/build-aim-art.py.
units: arc: texture pixels. draw: DDTank TakeAimAsset units, multiplied by draw.scale into Brasa world pixels.

arc.note: Painted facing LEFT (forward = 9 o'clock), sweeping from 12 to about 7 o'clock; mirrored for facing right and turned with the body tilt.
